aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test evidence but changed-factor grouping and one extracted outcome are not reliable enough for final Ask AI use.
issues: Primary factor should be laser marking vs primer clean, not implicit baseline vs combined conditions.
Lot/date and IR type are subgroup keys, not separate changed factors.
Normal plasma appears only in assy tension and should not define the whole baseline.
Function header row was incorrectly converted into measurement statistics.
Some cited evidence rows are not shown in context, limiting auditability.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to CD treatment/process comparison: laser marking CD vs primer clean CD, with plasma common.
Set subgroup keys for CD lot date, test date, IR/type, and normal plasma reference where applicable.
Remove dimension/spec from changed-factor domain; keep 1.2 kgf as outcome spec context.
Delete the spurious measurement outcome from the function header and keep function as defect counts.
Include cited rows 23, 32, 39, 48, and 51 in context or remove unsupported citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are mostly sufficient but need missing cited rows exposed and header-derived metrics removed.
